title: Donaldson-Sun Theory in the Conic Case
summary: We extend the Donaldson-Sun theory of metric tangent cones to non-collapsing Gromov-Hausdorff limits of conical Kahler-Einstein pairs whose boundary coefficients lie in a fixed finite subset of Q, and prove uniqueness of the log metric tangent cone. Furthermore, under a mild lc compatibility condition, we relate this with the Li-Xu and Li-Liu-Xu stable degeneration machinery.
